title: Transportation
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="25px"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Transportation"]

Whatever may be there in mind, at first the parents and students who are willing to join a technical course are worried about the basic facilities and academics, Such as faculties, lab, library, campus selection, and transportation. Because most of the engineering colleges are away from city premises, and they look for ambient atmosphere along with another basic facility.The day the college has opened in the heart of Mysore city it is been providing transport facility from all corners of the city to the college.

Since both the Teaching and Non-teaching Staffs are using transportation there is good coordination with staff and students. Moreover, adding to that there is no mandatory for opting of college bus for students, if they are willing they can use these facilities. Around 500 people are using these facilities at present.
